source.citation: Analytical solar internal-rotation profile reproducing the helioseismic fit used in Schou et al. (1998) / Charbonneau et al. (1999), coefficients reproduced in MNRAS 506, 2189 (2021), Eq. 7.

coordinate_convention.frame: sidereal angular velocity; record stores Omega/2pi in nHz and evaluator returns rad/s

representation.basis: omega0_over_2pi_nHz = c0 + c2*cos(theta)^2 + c4*cos(theta)^4 at r=0.700 R_sun, obtained by evaluating the published transition profile at r_t where erf(0)=0

validity.derivation: At r=r_t the transition factor is one half, so Omega0=(Omega_RZ+Omega_SCZ(theta))/2.

outcome_independence.selection_basis: Published helioseismic rotation fit selected and frozen before any BURGAMOTS M0/M1 response exists.
